newsitem.title: POLAND: Zloty fixed flat at 2.49 pct from NBP parity rate.
newsitem.headline: Zloty fixed flat at 2.49 pct from NBP parity rate.

text.p: The National Bank of Poland fixed the zloty at 3.1565 to the dollar, up from 3.1685 on Tuesday, and at 1.8365 to the mark, down from 1.8305, the NBP said.
The central bank fixed the zloty at an average of 2.49 percent from the weighted dollar and mark parity rates, flat from Tuesday's 2.48 percent fix.

According to Reuters' calculations, the zloty was fixed at 2.47 percent from the floating parity rate, which changes in line with intraday currency moves on world markets, against Tuesday's fix at 2.35 percent.
